description: Source code for the MultiRegionClient class in the AWS SDK for PHP, implementing multi-region AWS service client functionality with region and partition management.

classes.name: MultiRegionClient
classes.description: A multi-region AWS service client supporting region and partition configuration, with methods for command creation and client pooling.

methods.name: getArguments
methods.description: Returns default arguments configuration for the client, including service and region options, and client factory and partition setup.

methods.name: getRegion
methods.description: Retrieves the default region the client is configured to use.

methods.name: getCommand
methods.description: Creates a new command object for a specified operation name with given arguments.

methods.name: getConfig
methods.description: Returns the client's configuration options or a specific option if provided.

methods.name: getCredentials
methods.description: Retrieves credentials from the client pool.

methods.name: getHandlerList
methods.description: Returns the handler list used for request processing.

methods.name: getApi
methods.description: Returns the API description for the client.

methods.name: getEndpoint
methods.description: Returns the endpoint URL the client is configured to use.

methods.name: useCustomHandler
methods.description: Sets a custom handler for request processing.

methods.name: isUseCustomHandler
methods.description: Checks if a custom handler is set.

methods.name: getClientFromPool
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a regionalized client instance from the pool based on region.

methods.name: parseClass
methods.description: Parses the class name to determine the service name.

methods.name: getRegionFromArgs
methods.description: Extracts the region from command arguments or defaults to the client's region.
